governance.note: Identical lever set and governance to pjm_38 (the retiree-cap keeper config reproduced via _pjm_retiree_run.py): active levers all trace to measured inputs — CAMPD unit-level net-load-filtered outage windows (campd-unit-outages-PJM.csv, exogenous availability keyed on net load, not price) plus the within-window retiree CEMS availability cap (retiree_cems_cap), EIA-860 cogen-flagged BTM CHP host steam pulled out of the LP (btm.parquet), measured F923 per-plant monthly delivered gas (gas_monthly_actuals + coal_plant_monthly_pricing), measured EIA-860 dual-fuel oil-parity switching, the forecast-grade reference-price interchange interface (neighbor gas x heat-rate x load-shape with a hurdle), grounded per-band offer-curve heat-rate multipliers from CAMPD-derived committed/peaking tranches, and the coal-BIT passthrough sigmoid. No adder/haircut/sigmoid tuned to the price or volume residual; no unit pinned to its observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled so the model output lands on actuals.
governance.campd_benchmark_fix_note: This run is the pjm_38 config re-solved after fixing a NaN-propagation bug in campd.plant_hourly_net (np.add.at propagated NaN gross from offline units on the unit-level extracts, halving the per-plant CAMPD benchmark for multi-unit coal/CT plants on OH/WV/IN/KY/VA). The fix is BENCHMARK-ONLY: the model-facing CT-shape path (run_calibration ct_campd_shape) is gated on ct_mustrun_per_plant=False here, and the outage/retiree caps read their own pre-derived CSV/parquet, so the LP dispatch is unchanged. The corrected per-plant CAMPD series (coal-bit ~104-128 TWh vs the broken ~48-61) makes the charts-page per-class hourly r / NRMSE valid. EIA-923 remains the class-total gate. Coal-tot scores +9.2 / +1.6 / +9.4% (2023/24/25) on current data; the residual coal over-run is the documented export-driven / LMP-suppression issue (docs/multi-iso/pjm-coal-overrun-decomp-2026-06.md), not a benchmark or coal-cost artifact.
